gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.alien_core: The rarest meteor prize. An intact Alien Core is the key to the deepest alien technology — the heart of a future upgrade tree.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.alien_tech: Rarer meteors carry Alien Tech Scrap — the raw material of the scanners and upgrades to come. Hoard it.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.battery.te: Batteries buffer the grid: generators fill them, machines drain them through the pipe network. Build one before your first rocket launch window.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.cindara.te: Cindara is a volcanic moon: fire-immune stalkers, lava fields and cindrite. Heat-graded gear recommended.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.cindrite.t: Cindrite crystals upgrade your oxygen suit to Tier 2 and gate the deepest progression. Mine them from Cindara's stone.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.combustion: The Combustion Generator burns coal, charcoal or fuel canisters into energy. It is your first power source — pipe its output to your machines.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.configurat: The Configurator sets per-face pipe modes (in / out / off) so you can route exactly what flows where.
Glacira's cold drains an unprotected suit four times faster and frosts your visor. The glacite-lined Cryo Suit keeps you warm — all four pieces, or no shield.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.frame_casi: Frame Casing is a hollow ring of nerosteel. The quarry spends one casing per frame block as it materialises its glowing structural frame around the region.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.gas_tank.t: Gas Tanks store oxygen piped from a generator. A tank by your base door acts as an airlock — suits refill from it automatically.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.glacira.te: Glacira is an ice moon: pale frozen plains, stilt-legged striders and glacite. The last stop before you turn a world green.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.glacite.te: Glacite is crystallised water-ice — the key to cold-weather suits and, one day, to giving a terraformed world its water. Mine it from Glacira's stone.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.greenxertz: Greenxertz: a green-steel world of nerosteel and xertz quartz — and the creatures that guard them. The air is thin; bring a suit.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.hydration_: A Hydration Module touching your Terraformer melts glacite into water for the Hydrated stage — basins fill into lakes behind the green frontier.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.living_wor: Behind the water, the land matures: natural colour, trees, rain — and the first herds. Stand on Living ground and watch a world breathe on its own.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.meteor_sit: Meteors crash on the Overworld and the planets, leaving a small crater around a glowing Meteor Core. Break the core to claim Alien Fragments and a jump-start of off-world ores — hold a Meteor Tracker to find the way.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.nerosium_d: Grind raw nerosium into dust, then smelt the dust into ingots — two for one.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.nerosium_g: The Nerosium Grinder doubles your ore yield by grinding raw nerosium into dust. It needs power from the grid — see the Power Grid chapter.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.nerosium_i: Smelt raw nerosium in any furnace. The ingot is your basic crafting metal for machines, rockets and tools.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.nerosium_p: Nerosium tools sit at iron tier with better durability. You will be mining a lot — craft the pickaxe.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.nerosteel_: Nerosteel is Greenxertz's primary metal — mine the ore and smelt it. Higher-tier rockets and suits are built from it.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.new_life.t: Each planet wakes its own livestock: the Meadow Loper, the Ember Strutter, the Woolly Drift. Feed a pair their favourite crop and breed the first generation born off Earth.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.oxygen_gen: The Oxygen Generator electrolyses grid power into oxygen and pressurises the space around it. Sealed rooms fill completely; open air only holds a bubble.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.oxygen_sui: A full four-piece Oxygen Suit is portable life support: a finite air tank that drains slowly off safe zones and refills at airlocks.
The cindrite-upgraded Tier 2 suit doubles your air and refills twice as fast. A mixed set counts as Tier 1 — wear all four pieces.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.passive_ge: The Passive Generator trickles energy from a nerosium core for a long time — weaker than combustion but completely hands-off.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.quarry_con: Place the Controller beside the landmarks (or beside a closed rectangle of hand-placed Frame Casing — no landmarks needed), load it with Frame Casing and feed it power. It builds the frame, then a gantry-mounted drill excavates the interior layer by layer down to bedrock — sucking up liquids, skipping tile-entity columns, and auto-ejecting drops into adjacent storage or pipes. When the dig finishes, the frame is dismantled and its casings return to the controller.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.quarry_lan: Place three Quarry Landmarks in an L to mark a rectangle — they project guide lines along the ground. Their reference height is the top of the dig.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.raw_nerosi: Nerosium ore veins thread the overworld's stone. Mine them with an iron pickaxe or better — the raw red metal is the seed of everything that follows.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.rocket_fue: Rockets burn rocket fuel. Off-world trips reserve a return launch up front, then pack that fuel into the generated Landing Pod or Docking Port.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.rocket_lau: Launch pads tier up by footprint: a single pad launches Tier 1, a 3x3 launches Tier 2, a 3x3 ringed with Station Wall launches Tier 3, and a 5x5 with a Launch Gantry (Heavy Launch Complex) launches Tier 4. Right-click a pad empty-handed to read its tier.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.rocket_tie: The Tier 1 rocket reaches the Orbital Station. Bring enough fuel for the outbound burn and the reserve burn home.
Tier 2 adds Greenxertz to your destinations. It needs station materials, so establish yourself in orbit first.
Tier 3 reaches Cindara. Its launch pad must be ringed with Station Wall — the blast would melt anything less.
Tier 4 reaches Glacira, the frozen edge of the system. Built around a cindrite core, it launches only from a Heavy Launch Complex (5x5 pad + gantry).
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.station.te: The Orbital Station is your first destination — vacuum-cold and airless. Your arrival Docking Port is a safe zone and carries your return kit.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.station_ch: Craft a Station Charter and right-click it to name and found your own orbital station — it builds an enclosed room, an airlock, and a landing pad in orbit, no travel needed. Fly a rocket and choose the Orbital Station to visit (or pick New Station in the rocket to found one on the way). The unbreakable Station Core anchors it permanently; right-click the Core to rename it (founder only).
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.terraforme: Terraformed ground is permanently breathable. Stand on land your machine reclaimed and breathe without a suit — the end of the beginning.
The Terraformer converts dead ground into living, breathable terrain in an expanding circle. Energy is the throttle — feed it well.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.thermal_su: Cindara's heat makes any other suit burn air four times faster. The Thermal Suit (Tier 2 piece + cindrite) shrugs it off — all four pieces, or no shield.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.universal_: One pipe carries everything: energy, fluids, gas and items. Pipes form networks that balance their contents and feed adjacent machines.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.upgrade_mo: Slot cross-machine upgrade modules into the Controller: Speed digs faster, Efficiency cuts power use, Fortune or Silk Touch change what the dig drops, and an Evaporator boils away any water or lava the dig hits instead of buffering it — just like enchanting your pickaxe.

quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.first_ner: You smelted your first Nerosium ingot. Every voyage starts with a single bar of strange metal.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.grinder_o: You built a Nerosium Grinder. Meteor rock now yields its secrets to your machines.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.industria: You brought industry to your corner of the world. The hum of machines will carry you skyward.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.launch_re: You assembled a launch pad and your first rocket. The countdown is yours to begin.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.reached_o: You slipped the bonds of the Overworld and reached orbit. The stars are no longer a ceiling.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.station_v: You set foot aboard an orbital station. A harbour among the stars, built by your own hands.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.breathe_e: You sealed yourself into a full oxygen suit. Vacuum is just another weather now.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.first_col: You founded a colony beyond the sky. Somewhere out there, people now call a new place home.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.greenxert: You landed on Greenxertz, the first alien world to feel your boots.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.cindara.d: You braved the heat of Cindara and carried home a shard of cindrite.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.glacira.d: You crossed the frozen wastes of Glacira and returned with glacite in hand.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.deep_spac: You pushed past every known horizon into deep space. The log is yours; the stars remember.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.stalker_h: You faced down five Xertz Stalkers and lived to write about it.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.freighter: You built a cargo rocket. Trade routes between worlds are now within reach.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.alien_rel: You recovered an alien core from the wreckage of a fallen meteor. Someone was here before you.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.first_fre: Your first cargo flight touched down and unloaded without you at either pad. The supply line is open.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.terraform: You stood on dead ground your Terraformer has taken root in. The first stage of a living world.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.living_wo: You walked on ground you made fully living: hydrated, weathered and green. A world is breathing because of you.
quest.nerospace.starfarers_log.hundred_f: Freight on this world has crossed a hundred deliveries. The pads never sleep.
